name: TC-915: 3DS failed in the page — payment error, nothing charged
description: Same card, FAIL on the in-page bank check. Checkout stays, shows the payment error and keeps the cart; no confirm-payment; the order stays INITIALIZED, the PaymentIntent is requires_payment_method (nothing charged) and the owner sees no order.
